name: stevepridemore-graph-memory
description: Personal knowledge graph for Claude on Neo4j. Typed entities (Person/Project/Decision/Preference/Concept), bi-temporal edge validity (`valid_at`/`invalid_at`), per-type weighted decay, contradiction detection, and a nightly "dream" extraction process. Local bge-small-en embeddings, no API keys. Optional OAuth 2.1 + Cloudflare Tunnel for cross-device use across Claude Code, Desktop, web, and iOS.
install:
# git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/stevepridemore/graph-memory
# See source for mcpServers config block
